description: This script contains functions to manage pull request preparation workflows including branch resolution, initialization, validation, synchronization, and pushing. It automates Git operations and PR metadata handling in a CI/CD pipeline.

methods.name: checkout_prep_branch
methods.description: Checks out the preparation branch based on PR number.

methods.name: resolve_prep_branch_name
methods.description: Resolves the name of the PR prep branch; verifies its existence.

methods.name: verify_prep_branch_matches_prepared_head
methods.description: Ensures that the local prep branch contains the expected commit.

methods.name: prepare_init
methods.description: Initializes the preparation environment for a PR, including branch setup and environment variables.

methods.name: prepare_validate_commit
methods.description: Validates the latest commit message on the PR to exclude PR number or contributor thanks.

methods.name: prepare_push
methods.description: Pushes the prepared branch to the PR branch after passing gates.

methods.name: prepare_sync_head
methods.description: Syncs the prep head with origin/main, rebasing if necessary, and updates metadata.

methods.name: prepare_run
methods.description: Runs the full preparation sequence: init, gates, push.
